comment: The distributed targets and their ADR-0006 support tiers, in one place.
Read by scripts/lib/release-common.sh and, through it, by npm-pack.sh, the
Homebrew generator, the release-policy gate and the release workflow. Before
this file the same tier split was written out independently in five scripts
with nothing checking that they agreed.
Target names are stored bare, without the `tl-` asset prefix: the task-ID
lint reads that prefix followed by Crockford digits as a tracker reference,
and every consumer composes the asset name as `tl-<target>` for that reason.
tier `supported` is release-blocking; tier `best-effort` is built and
smoke-tested but a failing leg does not stop the release, so every consumer
must have a defined behaviour for its absence.
